adapter.name: chief-mcp
adapter.description: Generated MCP-AQL adapter for the Chief MCP server (mcp.chief.bot).

attach_label.review_reason: Attaches a label to an existing record; undone by detach_label.

detach_label.review_reason: Removes a label association from an existing record; undone by attach_label.

enable_skill.review_reason: Toggles an existing skill's enabled flag.

disable_skill.review_reason: Toggles an existing skill's enabled flag.

enable_action.review_reason: Toggles an existing action's enabled flag. Enabling can resume scheduled or triggered runs, so it requires confirmation.

disable_action.review_reason: Toggles an existing action's enabled flag.

regenerate_share_link.review_reason: Rotates an existing share link; the old link stops working for everyone holding it.

set_chat_visibility.review_reason: Changes who can see an existing chat; widening visibility can expose its contents.

upload_file.review_reason: Creates a new asset; removable with delete_asset.

send_message.review_reason: Posts a message other members see and may start a Chief agent turn; not undoable from the reader's side.

create_project_invitation.review_reason: Emails an outside address immediately and can grant the owner role.

create_share_link.review_reason: Makes the chat readable by anyone with the URL, without authentication.

add_chat_member.review_reason: Widens who can read a restricted chat.

create_action.review_reason: Actions start enabled and run on their schedule or trigger without further confirmation.

update_action.review_reason: A full replacement can enable the action or change its schedule, trigger, or prompt.
